text.p: Lloyd's of London on Monday said on Monday this year's round of auctions of 1998 syndicate capacity would open on July 8, with a total of eight auctions to be held.
The dates are: July 8, July 22, August 5, August 19, September 2, September 9, September 16 and September 23.
This year's round will be the third in which investors can buy and sell participations in insurance syndicates for the next year.
A few adjustments have been made to the auction process.

Unlike last year, successful bidders will pay their bid price instead of a common strike price and each auction will run for two days and will be fully conducted on an electronic system, Lloyd's of London said.
